mainEntity.name: What tools are needed for kitchen faucet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic tools for kitchen faucet installation often include an adjustable wrench, basin wrench, pliers, screwdriver, utility knife, and a bucket for drips. Depending on the faucet type and existing setup, additional tools like a drill or pipe cutter might be necessary. Having these tools ready can streamline the installation process. Customers should confirm if specialized tools are required for their chosen faucet model.
